## Summary

Addresses the managed PDB ID portion of item 5 of #135314: use `BlobContentId.GetTimeBasedProvider()` for nondeterministic PDB IDs, giving a random GUID and time-based stamp instead of the constant stamp `0x04030201`. Preserve deterministic IDs and content hashing.

The PdbChecksum debug-directory timestamp intentionally remains zero, following SRM rather than native ilasm. This does not fix the native-only issues #135211 or #135214. This branch is independently based on main and does not include the debug-attribute change.

## Validation already run

```powershell
$env:DOTNET_ROLL_FORWARD='LatestMajor'
$env:DOTNET_HOST_PATH='E:\copilot-worktrees\runtime\dev-jkoritzinsky-glowing-meme\artifacts\bin\testhost\net11.0-windows-Debug-x64\dotnet.exe'
.\.dotnet\dotnet.exe test src\tools\ilasm\tests\ILAssembler.Tests --filter 'FullyQualifiedName~CompilerOptionsTests' -- "RunConfiguration.DotNetHostPath=$env:DOTNET_HOST_PATH"
```

Result: branch rebuilt; 44 passed, 0 failed/skipped. The common corrected-reader testhost was reused, not added to this branch. No new test runs were performed for PR publication.
